name: guido
description: Configuration, compiled. Bundles the guido skill + the hosted Guido MCP server so Codex can read a config file you already have, change one value, and hand back a valid one — in JSON, YAML, INI, .env, .properties or as a command-line flag string. Rules decide what may be set together, so contradictory combinations are refused rather than shipped.

interface.shortDescription: Configuration, compiled — one template, every format.
interface.longDescription: Guido turns a configuration file into fields with rules. Ask for a value to change and it applies the rules, refuses contradictions, and renders the result as JSON, YAML, INI, .env, .properties or a launcher flag string. Paste a command line you already run and get it back corrected.
